title: Banned for asking unban for my friend

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
You didn't get banned for that, you got banned because we think that you and "your friend" are the same person and that you were using this account to be able to play even with the other account banned.

Is there any way you can prove us wrong?

Cheers,
Javi

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,


Oh come on! No need to be grumpy ): Seriously though, after reviewing your provided evidence, I've decided to unban you. Regardless, let me clarify WHY you got banned in the first place, and it certainly was not because you said "unban my friend" in chat, as soon as you said that, Javipepe conducted an IP check on you, and from the looks of it, you and the a banned user had logged on with the same IP address , thus he punished you thinking that you're an alternative account.

Thanks!!!
